method.search: Starting from the retained 55-tile period-55440 assignment, fix prime 5 at shift zero as a global translation normalization. For each of the other 30 base tiles, remove it and score every shift by the exact number of surviving 11-by-11 fiber holes it removes. Then score every shift of all 24 lift tiles against the exact current base residual. Repeat until a complete sweep changes no shift or three sweeps complete.
method.stopping_rule: After this declaration is committed, run the frozen producer once and the source-first checker once. Retain the joint polish only if the checker recovers the full coordinate family, all 3,073,593,600 point outcomes, the exact 3,206-hole improvement, the rooted residual, and least-shift coordinate optimality for all 54 non-normalizing tiles.

next_obligation: Lift the exact joint-local residual through the cheapest useful compatible prime factor; only a zero-hole full-pool certificate can enter the affine verifier.
nonclaims: This 55-tile assignment is not an exact cover.
Coordinate-wise optimality is not global or multi-coordinate optimality.
Fixing prime 5 removes translation symmetry but does not establish uniqueness.
The discarded sampled candidates establish no result.
A bounded period-55440 residual is not evidence that no finite cover exists.
The producer and checker are not a Vela Verification or Decision.

preknowledge.disclosure: A large sampled joint search produced candidates that failed exact comparison and were discarded. A subsequent exact all-coordinate exploration observed the single prime-3361 shift change, residual, and zero-change confirmation sweep before this qualification was frozen.
preknowledge.effect: The iteration receives no Claim credit. Its retained value is exact qualification of the full one-coordinate local optimum and evidence that sampled winner selection was not reliable at this improvement scale.
